questions.section: General questions for all respondents about the Acquisition
questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Kimberly-Clark and/or Kenvue and whether your business competes with Kimberly-Clark or Kenvue (and if so, the nature of that competition).

questions.section: General questions for all respondents about the Acquisition
questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Kimberly-Clark and Kenvue are close competitors. If so, identify for which product type(s), and the extent to which there are alternatives suppliers available.

questions.section: General questions for all respondents about the Acquisition
questions.text: Do you consider the increased range of brands that would be in Kimberly- Clark’s portfolio post-Acquisition would increase its bargaining power with customers? If so, how would this affect competition?

questions.section: General questions for all respondents about the Acquisition
questions.text: Do you consider the Acquisition is likely to lead to an increased ability for Kimberly-Clark to link (e.g. through volume discounts or rebates) the products it supplies to customers? If so, is this likely to make it harder for suppliers of competing products to compete?

questions.section: General questions for all respondents about the Acquisition
questions.text: In particular, do you consider the Acquisition is likely to lead to Kimberly-Clark having an increased ability to link products in the baby care category (or an increased ability to acquire greater shelf space), through the combination of Kimberly-Clark’s Huggies nappies and wipes with Kenvue’s Aveeno and Johnson’s baby toiletries. If so, do you consider this is likely to make it harder for suppliers of competing baby products to compete?

questions.section: General questions for all respondents about the Acquisition
questions.text: Provide any additional information or comments you consider relevant to the ACCC's consideration of the Acquisition.

questions.section: Questions for all respondents about the proposed divestiture
questions.text: Describe the extent to which Kimberley-Clark’s Remedy Offer would address any concerns you have in relation to the Acquisition.

questions.section: Questions for all respondents about the proposed divestiture
questions.text: Outline any concerns you consider would not be resolved by the divestiture of the Divestiture Business.

questions.section: Questions for all respondents about the proposed divestiture
questions.text: Provide your view on whether the Divestiture Business that Kimberley-Clark is proposing to divest is likely to attract a suitable purchaser, and the qualities a suitable purchaser would possess.

questions.section: Questions for all respondents about the proposed divestiture
questions.text: What type of manufacturing arrangements or capabilities do you consider a suitable purchaser of the Divestiture Business would require to be successful?

questions.section: Questions for all respondents about the proposed divestiture
questions.text: What factors may impact effective implementation of the divestiture proposal e.g., undertaking drafting, and any third party consents (including regulatory) required.

questions.section: Questions for all respondents about the proposed divestiture
questions.text: What are the key assets, rights and personnel required to ensure a potential purchaser of the Divestiture Business can become a viable, effective, and long-term competitor in the supply of relevant feminine hygiene products in Australia.

questions.section: Questions for all respondents about the proposed divestiture
questions.text: Provide any additional information or comments you consider relevant to the ACCC's consideration of the Remedy Offer.
